searches.query: How much of my annual membership fee will I get back if I cancel after using the free-shipping benefit?

chunks.text: Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.

Check the lithium-delivery and oversize-delivery articles before promising this service. A customer cannot pay a surcharge to remove a product restriction. The membership benefit covers qualifying standard delivery only. It does not discount the USD 18 express price or change the cutoff time.

The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status. Check the customer's membership record before applying benefits to a live order. Refund treatment for an already-used membership is not specified in this policy.

Standard delivery prices  For ordinary parcels to the contiguous United States, standard ground delivery costs USD 6 when the qualifying merchandise subtotal is below USD 75. At USD 75 or more, standard delivery is free. The qualifying subtotal is calculated after discounts and before sales tax. Gift cards do not count toward it. A basket that was above the threshold before a discount may fall below it afterward.  An active store membership reduces the free standard-delivery threshold to USD 40. The membership must be active when the order is placed. Becoming a member later does not retroactively refund an earlier delivery charge. Membership is linked to the purchasing customer, not automatically to everyone at the same address.  Oversize products have a separate delivery charge and do not receive free delivery under either threshold. The oversize-delivery article explains the fee. Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery.

Who pays for a return label  For ordinary domestic change-of-mind returns, the store offers a ground label for USD 7 per parcel. If the customer uses it, USD 7 is deducted from the refund or store credit. A customer may instead arrange and pay for their own suitable carrier. A store label covers one parcel; two parcels require two labels. Membership does not waive this fee.  An approved wrong-item shipment or manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid label without the USD 7 deduction. The support team must approve that reason first. A customer selecting a defect reason in the portal is not sufficient proof that the claim has been approved. The hiking boot fit trial is a fit return, so the normal USD 7 label fee applies unless the customer supplies their own shipping.  Use suitable packaging and keep the carrier acceptance receipt. Items containing an undamaged lithium battery must use the eligible ground service.

The return-label fee follows the ordinary return-label policy. A recipient may use their own carrier if they do not want to buy the store label. This article does not describe the expiration date or transferability of store credit.

Express service has its own price and restrictions; free standard delivery does not mean free express delivery. Any original outbound shipping charge remains separate from the item price when the customer later makes a change-of-mind return. The checkout presents the final delivery options before payment.

A return request is not itself a refund. Customers receive a receipt after the inspection is complete. Original outbound delivery charges are not refunded for a change of mind. The return-label policy explains who pays for sending an item back. Do not send an item to the warehouse without an approved return request.

Refund allocation for discounted bundles  When a bundle has one discounted purchase price, allocate that price across its items in proportion to their individual prices at the time of purchase. Refunding one eligible item returns that allocated paid amount. It does not return the item's current price or its undiscounted original price. Retaining other items does not by itself cancel the allocation.  The camping starter kit contains a lantern listed at USD 30, a stove listed at USD 50, and a carry case listed at USD 20. Their individual prices total USD 100. When the customer paid USD 80 for the kit, the allocated paid amounts are USD 24 for the lantern, USD 40 for the stove, and USD 16 for the case. These amounts total the USD 80 actually paid.  The allocation determines money, not return eligibility. Check the condition, return window, gift status, and transport restrictions separately.

answer.answer: The supplied policies do not specify the refund treatment for an already-used membership. The annual membership costs USD 24, but the documents do not state whether using benefits such as free shipping affects the refund amount upon cancellation.
